title: Dynamic Product Catalog
description: Create a catch-all route to handle product categories and display the category path.
problemStatement:
## Goal Build a dynamic product listing page that handles nested categories like `/products/electronics/phones`. ### Requirements 1. Create a file `pages/products/[...categories].js`. 2. The component should: - Use `useRouter` to get `categories` from the query. - Display `

Products

` and then show the category path (e.g., "Category: electronics > phones"). - If no categories (which can't happen with `[...]` but might with `[[...]]`), display "All Products". 3. Add a link from the homepage to `/products/electronics/phones` to test the route. 4. Ensure navigating to `/products/books` or `/products/clothing/shirts` all work and display the correct path. ### Bonus Convert it to optional catch-all `[[...categories]].js` and handle `/products` (root) showing "All Products".
hints: `categories` will be an array. Use `.join(' > ')` to display a breadcrumb.
For optional catch‑all, check if `categories` is undefined or empty.
expectedOutput: Page at `/products/electronics/phones` shows 'Category: electronics > phones'. The bonus root path `/products` shows 'All Products'.
